title: Bicycle warning strip
body_html:
No tools are needed, and it can be fixed on the spokes of the wheel with just one click, not afraid of the sun and rain, let alone the falling off of the card!

The new reflective clip, the internal buckle structure is cross-shaped, the clip is firmer, and normal bicycle spokes can be used.

Note: Only round steel wire [spokes] can be installed. This product is made of reflective material, does not emit light by itself, and does not contain fluorescent agent

Single length: 8 cm (normal mountain bike spokes are about 24 cm long)

Inner diameter: 1.9-2.4mm outer diameter: 5mm

Quantity:12pieces a set
